summary_en: This Phase 1b study tests autologous CD22 CAR T cells, a treatment made from the patient's own cells, in adults with relapsed or refractory B cell lymphomas and related B cell cancers. The treatment is given as an infusion after lymphodepleting chemotherapy, and participants stay in the hospital about 5 to 7 days (plus or minus 2); how often it is given is not stated. The study measures safety and efficacy, and participants are followed for overall survival, progression-free survival, and duration of response.
summary_es: Este estudio de fase 1b evalúa las células CAR T autólogas dirigidas a CD22, un tratamiento elaborado con las propias células del paciente, en adultos con linfomas de células B recidivantes o refractarios y cánceres relacionados de células B. El tratamiento se administra como infusión después de quimioterapia de linfodepleción, y los participantes permanecen en el hospital aproximadamente de 5 a 7 días (más o menos 2); la frecuencia de administración no se indica. El estudio mide la seguridad y la eficacia, y los participantes son seguidos para supervivencia global, supervivencia libre de progresión y duración de la respuesta.
who_for: Adults 18 or older with a confirmed B cell lymphoma or related cancer listed in the study.
Relapsed or refractory disease after prior systemic therapy, as defined for each cancer type.
Measurable disease, or leukemic cells or disease above 2% by flow cytometry, depending on the cancer type.
Archival tissue available, or willingness to have a biopsy, to check CD22 expression.
Adequate performance status (ECOG 0, 1, or 2, or Karnofsky above 60%).
not_for: Rapidly progressive disease that could prevent completing study therapy.
Other active cancer, with limited exceptions such as non-melanoma skin cancer.
Ongoing HIV, HBV, or HCV infection.
